rationale: The production roadmap identifies Human Gate split-brain and D0-D5 enforcement as a critical governance blocker. This change moves the D3-D5 terminal decision rationale requirement into the canonical governance ticket store, allows escalated tickets to resolve through the same lifecycle, and closes API/mobile/legacy bypass paths so approval behavior is consistent across governance tickets, legacy HumanGate, operator mobile, funding and deploy flows. It is D4 because it changes architecture-level governance enforcement across multiple runtime planes.

steps: Revert the TicketStore resolution-policy guard and escalated-ticket resolution change.
Revert API/mobile/legacy route ValueError-to-422 handling added for D3+ rationale enforcement.
Revert the test fixture hook-isolation changes if they are no longer needed after rollback.
Run governance, operator_mobile, funding, round_meta, deploy and integration regression suites twice.
Confirm that D3-D5 approvals are still blocked by an alternative production policy before deploying any rollback.

fidelity_test.description: Verify D3-D5 Human Gate approvals and rejections require an operator rationale through canonical, legacy and mobile routes while funding, deploy, skills and round-meta flows still resolve correctly.
pre_conditions: Governance ticket store starts from a clean in-memory database in tests.
Legacy HumanGate and operator mobile route singletons are reset by test fixtures.
Funding and round-meta post-resolve hooks are explicitly registered in tests that depend on them.
steps: Run governance ticket store and legacy HumanGate policy tests.
Run operator mobile route tests including missing-rationale D4 decision.
Run round-meta and BE8 post-approval tests.
Run funding governance bridge, browser automation and funding route tests.
Run deploy route, unified-truth, S4, S7 and skills Human Gate tests.
Repeat the same combined suite a second time without code changes.
fidelity_test.expected_outcome: D3-D5 approvals without rationale return validation errors or raise ValueError, escalated tickets can be resolved, and all dependent flows pass twice.
